summary.text: Tasha Boerner Horvath is a Democratic member of the California State Assembly who has represented District 77 since 2018 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Trinity Hannaway.
She chairs the Communications and Conveyance Committee.

paragraphs.text: Tasha Boerner Horvath was born in Encinitas, California, where she lives, and graduated from Poly High School.
She earned a bachelor's degree in political science from the University of California, Berkeley, in 1995 and a master's degree in international studies from Claremont Graduate University in 1998.

Her career experience includes work as a business owner, planning commissioner for the City of Encinitas, and senior communications manager for INTO University Partnerships and for Deutsche Telekom and T-Mobile International.
Boerner Horvath was elected to the Encinitas City Council in 2016, and her Assembly tenure began in 2018.

In 2025 and 2026, she chairs the Communications and Conveyance Committee and sits on the Higher Education, Public Employment and Retirement, Utilities and Energy, Water, Parks, and Wildlife, and Fisheries and Aquaculture committees.
She advanced from the June 2, 2026 primary.
